title: Billing Lag Days Added to Net Terms in the Commercial Credit Account Terms Coverage
content:
**Schedule of billing lag days — Commercial Credit Account.** In the supported limit, the terms coverage is the tier's net terms days plus **the days added to the net terms days**, divided by thirty; the days added follow the account's billing.

### Clause

The days added to the net terms days in the terms coverage are sixty for an account billed monthly consolidated, forty for an account billed per shipment on paper delivery that was charged paper invoice fees in the last twelve whole months, and thirty otherwise.

The last twelve whole months are the paper invoice fees dated less than twelve whole months before today, whole months being the difference in calendar months less one when today's day of the month is earlier than the fee date's day of the month.

### Schedule

| Billing cycle | Invoice delivery | Paper invoice fee charged in the last twelve whole months | Days added |
|---|---|---|---|
| monthly consolidated | any | any | 60 |
| per shipment | paper | yes | 40 |
| per shipment | paper | no | 30 |
| per shipment | email or EDI | — | 30 |

### Examples (hypothetical)

- Net 30 tier, monthly consolidated: coverage 30 plus 60, divided by thirty, so 3.
- Net 30 tier, per shipment on paper with paper invoice fees in the last twelve whole months: 70 divided by thirty, two and one third.
